name: week
title: The harvest this week
subtitle: Read-only snapshot from the database. Demo records are fictional.

sections.title: Needs someone
sections.note: Council notices first, then the trucks, the mill, money, owners and contractors.
sections.sql: select item,harvest,record,owner,due_date,detail from v_attention order by case when item like 'NOTICE%' or item like 'PLAN%' then 1 when item='OVERWEIGHT' then 2 when item like 'MILL%' then 3 when item='INVOICE OVERDUE' then 4 else 5 end,due_date

sections.title: Loads in the last 7 days
sections.sql: select loaded_on,harvest,count(*)::int as loads,round(sum(tonnes),1) as tonnes,round(sum(sale_cents)/100.0) as value from v_loads where loaded_on>=current_date-7 group by loaded_on,harvest order by loaded_on desc,harvest

sections.title: Harvests
sections.sql: select harvest,forest,owner,crew,status,est_tonnes,tonnes,tonnes_left,tonnes_per_day,owner_net_per_tonne from v_harvests where status in ('active','planned') order by harvest

name: money
title: Log sales money
subtitle: Owed by buyers, owed to owners, owed to contractors.

sections.title: Owed by buyers
sections.sql: select state,customer,count(*)::int as items,round(sum(amount_cents)/100.0) as amount from v_receivables group by state,customer order by state,customer

sections.title: Owed to owners (received loads not on a return)
sections.sql: select owner,to_char(date_trunc('month',loaded_on),'YYYY-MM') as month,count(*)::int as loads,round(sum(tonnes),1) as tonnes,round(sum(sale_cents)/100.0) as sales,round(sum(owner_net_cents)/100.0) as owner_net from v_owner_lines where state='received' and owner_return_id is null group by owner,2 order by owner,2

sections.title: Price sheet in force
sections.sql: select c.name as customer,p.code as product,x.from_on,round(x.price_cents/100.0,2) as per_tonne from customers c cross join products p join lateral (select from_on,price_cents from sale_prices sp where sp.customer_id=c.id and sp.product_id=p.id and sp.from_on<=current_date order by from_on desc limit 1) x on true order by p.code,per_tonne desc

name: mill
title: Mill statements against dockets
subtitle: Dockets the mill has not reported, lines with no docket, and tonnes or values that differ.

sections.title: Differences
sections.sql: select issue,customer,docket,on_date,docket_tonnes,mill_tonnes,detail from v_reconcile order by issue,on_date

sections.title: Tonnes by buyer
sections.sql: select customer,count(*)::int as loads,round(sum(docket_tonnes),1) as docket_tonnes,round(sum(mill_tonnes),1) as mill_tonnes,round(sum(mill_tonnes)-sum(docket_tonnes),1) as difference from v_loads where mill_tonnes is not null group by customer order by customer

name: compliance
title: Record checks
subtitle: What the checks found against the rules in docs/compliance.md. Not legal or tax advice.

sections.title: Findings
sections.sql: select rule,harvest,record,finding,due_date,source from v_compliance order by rule,record

sections.title: Council notices
sections.sql: select harvest,forest,kind,starts_on,window_opens,give_by,given_on,plan_by,plan_in_place_on from v_notices order by starts_on
